data.message: I am not sure what I am doing wrong, but this is still bugged for me. I try to print any of the ammo types and it just sucks all the resin and doesn't stop. I cant reset it either. i tried different settings but this doesn't do anything print time cant go down to 1 anyway, it goes down to 5. Still bugged regardless

Found a bug IF the "Print Time" value is set to anything other than 1.0, then the Printer will use all of the resin already stored and continue to use all resin added to the printer in a never ending loop causing the printer to becoming unusable and never printing the ammo type selected. However IF the "Print Time" value is set to exactly 1.0, then the bug will not occur and will function normally printing any ammo type selected.
